FRACTURE LINE: MODERN CONFLICT — skirmish with four factions: United States, Russia, Germany and Iran.
Design, code, procedural 3D models (with automatic LODs), weathering and surface-detail shaders, decals, effects, maps, faction HUD themes, UI and text: original work made for Malachi Murphy with Grok Bot. US unit names are original and only inspired by real equipment roles.
Textures: ambientCG (ambientcg.com), CC0 1.0 public domain — Ground097, Ground109, Grass004, Rock063, Asphalt033, Gravel035, Concrete034, CorrugatedSteel005, Rust004; winter: Snow006, Ground054, Snow004, Rock035, Ice002, Snow010A; temperate: Grass001, Ground037, Rock023, PavingStones130; arid: Ground090, Ground102, Rock061, Ground079S.
Soldier models and animations: Quaternius, "Toon Shooter Game Kit" (quaternius.com), CC0 1.0 public domain — recoloured and re-equipped per faction, re-proportioned, decimated and baked to vertex animation.
Sound effects, the Germany music and the Russian "Steppe March" and Iranian "Zagros": original, synthesized for this game (no samples, no third-party audio).
Menu and United States music ("Base Command", "Defend the Border", "Mission Accomplished", "Zero Hour Background"): original music by Malachi Murphy.
Russia music ("Red Banner March", "Forward, Comrades", "Iron Rhythm (Zhelezny ritm)", "Moscow Techno" I and II, "Desionaries"): original music by Malachi Murphy.
Iran music ("Defend the Holy Land", "Iran Victory", "Triumph of the Dunes", "Descent into Dust", "Dusty Loop", "Setar's Waiting Riff", "Iron and Flower (Ahan o Gol)"): original music by Malachi Murphy.
Voices (AI-generated, original lines, no real person's voice cloned):
• Germany and US: Kokoro-82M speech model (hexgrad, Apache-2.0) via kokoro-onnx (MIT); phonemes by eSpeak NG (GPL-3.0 build tool, only audio ships).
• Iran (English with Persian accents): Chatterbox Multilingual (Resemble AI, MIT; output carries Resemble's Perth audio watermark), prompted with synthetic speakers derived from Piper Persian voices amir, ganji and reza_ibrahim (CC0 datasets, but fine-tuned from Piper's research-only "lessac" voice — licence not clearly permissive; these Iran voices will be replaced in a later update; Piper GPL-3.0 build tool only). Checked with faster-whisper / Whisper (MIT).

Winter. A frozen river splits north from south: two bridges, two ice fords, snowy pine forests and rock ridges. Garrisonable village houses on both banks.
Temperate. A canal runs through a small city: three bridges and a weir, a street grid of garrisonable blocks, farmland and oak woods around the bases.
Desert. A river town with three bridges and two fords, oil derricks and crude oil reserves by the town.

Armoured bulldozer. Builds and repairs base structures.
5-ton FMTV cargo truck. Loads surplus crude oil in drums at oil reserves and derricks and hauls it to a Supply Depot for export.
One Marine with a service rifle. Cheap, flexible, can garrison buildings.
Single soldier with a fire-and-forget anti-tank missile launcher. Locks on, then hits vehicles and helicopters hard.
Forward air controller with a carbine: wide sight, 35% stronger than a Rifleman. Sends idle aircraft at his target and boosts artillery and air strikes near him (+25% damage, tighter spread).
Invisible while standing still. Kills infantry with one shot; useless against vehicles. Needs a Strategic Center.
M1A3 main battle tank in desert tan. Heavy smoothbore gun, fast for its weight, very well armoured.
Joint Light Tactical Vehicle in desert tan. Fast, with a roof machine gun. Carries five infantry.
Woodland-camo infantry fighting vehicle with a 25mm chain gun. Carries six infantry who can fire from inside.
Mobile Anti Air System: launcher pods for aircraft plus a machine gun for light ground targets.
M109A7 self-propelled 155 mm howitzer. Tracked, long range, cannot hit close targets. Needs a Strategic Center.
Attack helicopter: missiles against vehicles, chin cannon against infantry and light vehicles. Reloads in the air, needs no airfield slot.
Air-superiority fighter: the best anti-air in the game, one light bomb for ground targets. Short rearm. Uses 2 airfield slots.
Heavy bomber: one devastating strike, then it lands and rearms (45 s). Uses 4 airfield slots. Needs a Strategic Center.
Nuclear power plant. Powers the base.
Warehouse supply drop-off. Comes with an M1083A1P2 Supply Truck.
Builds aircraft. 6 parking slots: bomber 4, fighter 2, gunship 0. Jets land here to rearm.
Tech centre: unlocks the Scout Sniper, M109A7 howitzer, Thunderlance Bomber and Data Center.
C-RAM air defence: trailer-mounted 20mm rotary gun, strong against aircraft, weak against ground targets. Needs power.
Emplaced M777A2 155mm howitzer that shells ground targets at long range. Needs power.
Server hall that brings in $500 a minute. Uses a lot of power.

Arid. A walled market town in a dry basin, ringed by a sandy wadi you can ford almost anywhere, with deep oasis pools on the diagonals. Mesas and salt flats outside; garrisonable town blocks inside.
Construction backhoe. Builds and repairs Iranian structures. Does not gather supplies.
Civilian pickup that loads crude oil drums and hauls them to a Supply Depot for export. Cannot build.
Iranian Army rifleman. Cheap, single soldier, can garrison.
IRGC soldier with an RPG-7. Strong against vehicles.
Army marksman with a Nakhjir sniper rifle. Hidden from the enemy unless shooting (nearby units and detectors still see him). Needs a Defence Workshop.
Unarmed Basij volunteer in civilian clothes who blends in with the population: always hidden, wide sight. Tap an enemy or neutral structure to capture it (6 s next to it).
Light military 4x4 jeep with a 12.7 mm DShK heavy machine gun. Fast raider; hits ground and air.
Karrar main battle tank with a 125 mm gun.
Tracked 35 mm anti-aircraft gun vehicle with a search radar and a counter-drone laser.
Tracked 155 mm self-propelled howitzer. Very long range; needs 5 s to set up after moving. Needs a Defence Workshop.
Fajr-5 rocket launcher truck. Lighter artillery, fires without setting up. Needs a Defence Workshop.
Twin-engine F-4E strike jet: heavy bombs against ground targets. Uses 2 airfield slots. Needs a Defence Workshop.
Light Kowsar fighter: air-to-air missiles and ground-attack rockets. Uses 2 airfield slots.
MiG-29 interceptor: the best Iranian air-to-air fighter, no ground attack. Uses 2 airfield slots.
Builds the Kowsar, the MiG-29 and the F-4E. 6 parking slots; every jet uses 2. Jets land here to rearm.

Desert metropolis. A dense downtown of glass and office towers fills the ground between the four bases: a street grid choked with parked cars, a wide central boulevard, plazas with supplies and garrisonable blocks.
Temperate city split by a river. Four avenue bridges and two edge fords link north and south; apartment towers, shop rows and parked cars line every street.
Riverside Metro after dark. Street lamps light the avenues, windows glow and every vehicle drives with its headlights on.
Varno Crossing under a desert moon. Bases are floodlit and headlights give away moving columns.
Tracked combat engineering vehicle with a dozer blade, a crane and a single-shot anti-tank rocket launcher. Builds and repairs structures.
The bucket-wheel excavator, packed up and crawling to a new site. It earns nothing until it sets up again. Tap Set Up on open ground; it takes 10 seconds.
Six-wheel military cargo truck. Loads surplus crude oil in drums and hauls it to a Supply Depot for export.
One soldier with an AK-74. Standard infantry, can garrison buildings.
One soldier with a PKM. High rate of fire, shreds infantry, weak against armour.
One soldier with an RPG-7V3. Anti-tank rockets, cannot hit aircraft.
FSB elite operator with a rifle and grenades. Hidden while standing still. Needs a Vehicle Factory.
Fast armoured 4x4 with a roof 12.7 mm machine gun. Carries 5 infantry, who can fire from inside.
BTR-82A 8x8 armoured personnel carrier with a 30 mm cannon. Carries 7 infantry, who can fire from inside.
Heavy mine-protected transport with a remote 12.7 mm gun. Carries 10 infantry and takes a lot of damage.
Main battle tank with a 125 mm gun and reactive armour.
2S19 Msta-S tracked 152 mm self-propelled howitzer. Long range, cannot fire up close. Needs a Supply Depot.
ZSU-23-4 tracked anti-aircraft gun with four 23 mm cannons. Also hits ground targets.
Stealth fighter: R-77 missiles against aircraft, guided bombs against ground targets. Uses 2 airfield slots.
Coaxial-rotor attack helicopter with Vikhr anti-tank missiles and a 30 mm cannon. Stays over the battle, no parking slot needed.
Huge, slow swing-wing bomber: a four-bomb carpet run, then it lands and rearms (52 s). Uses 4 airfield slots. Needs a Ministry of Defense.
Russian headquarters: red-brick walls, towers and palace. Engineer Vehicles roll out of its vehicle bay.

Concrete supply drop-off point. Comes with a Cargo Truck and builds more.

Twin 30 mm rotary anti-aircraft turret. Shreds aircraft, cannot hit ground targets. Needs power.
Builds Su-57, Ka-52 and Tu-160. 6 parking slots: bomber 4, fighter 2, helicopter 0. Jets land here to rearm.

Two players. Rolling hills, farm fields and gravel farm tracks between two corner bases, with a paved village square in the middle. Vehicles slow a little on the slopes.

Eight players. Corner and edge bases around a crown of high hills, with lakes, woods, farmland and a market town in the centre.
